info.name: Nile Clinic API
info.description:
Backend API of the Nile Clinic Management System (Laravel 13, `/api/v1`).

Contracts: `specs/001-project-foundation/contracts/health.openapi.yaml`,
`specs/002-staff-auth-roles/contracts/staff-auth.openapi.yaml`,
`specs/003-patient-records/contracts/patients.openapi.yaml`, and
`specs/004-doctors-specialties/contracts/doctors.openapi.yaml`.

**Run order**: System → Auth/sign in (stores `token`) → Auth → Staff → Patients → Specialties →
Doctors → Auth/sign out. Select the **Nile Clinic Local** environment and set `admin_email` /
`admin_password` to an administrator created with `php artisan staff:create-admin`. All data must
be synthetic.

Every request sends `Accept: application/json` and `Accept-Language: {{locale}}` (`en` or `ar`);
field names and structure are identical in both locales, only `message` texts change.

exec: pm.test('200 with the health contract body', () => {

request.description:
Reports whether the API can reach its database. Public, no input. 200 with "ok", or 503 with
"unavailable" and no internal details.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Sign in, the signed-in member's own account, and sign out (feature 002, US1 and US5).
Tokens expire after 8 hours without a request. After 5 failed attempts for one email, or 20
from one address, within a minute, sign-in is refused for up to a minute.

exec: pm.test('200 with a Bearer token and the account', () => {

request.description:
Sign in with email and password. Stores the returned token in the collection variable `token`,
which every other request sends as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. Unknown email, wrong
password, and deactivated account all get the same 422 message. Emails are printable ASCII;
case and surrounding spaces are ignored.

response.name: 422 Too many attempts
response.body: {"message": "Too many login attempts. Please try again in 55 seconds.", "errors": {"email": ["Too many login attempts. Please try again in 55 seconds."]}}

response.name: 422 Wrong credentials
response.body: {"message": "These credentials do not match our records.", "errors": {"email": ["These credentials do not match our records."]}}

exec: pm.test('200 with exactly the public fields', () => {

request.description: The signed-in staff member's own profile. Never includes the password.

Change your own password (12–72 characters, confirmed). Ends your other tokens; the token used
for this request stays valid. Wrong current passwords count toward the sign-in per-email limit.
This run sets the password to its current value, so the administrator's password is unchanged.

response.name: 422 Wrong current password
response.body: {"message": "The password is incorrect.", "errors": {"current_password": ["The password is incorrect."]}}

item.name: Staff
item.description:
Staff account management, administrators only (feature 002, US3). Receptionists and doctors
get 403. Ids are numeric; unknown ids get 404.

request.description: One page of staff accounts ordered by name, then id. Laravel's paginated shape: data, links, meta.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body: {"data": [{"id": 1, "name": "Test Admin", "email": "admin@clinic.test", "role": "administrator", "is_active": true, "created_at": "2026-10-27T16:26:43+00:00", "updated_at": "2026-10-27T16:26:43+00:00"}, {"id": 2, "name": "Test Reception", "email": "reception@clinic.test", "role": "receptionist", "is_active": true, "created_at": "2026-10-27T16:29:46+00:00", "updated_at": "2026-10-27T16:29:46+00:00"}], "links": {"first": "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/staff?per_page=15&page=1", "last": "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/staff?per_page=15&page=1", "prev": null, "next": null}, "meta": {"current_page": 1, "from": 1, "last_page": 1, "path": "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/staff", "per_page": 15, "to": 2, "total": 2}}

response.name: 403 Forbidden
response.body: {"message": "You are not allowed to perform this action."}

request.description:
Create an active account. Email: printable ASCII, unique among all accounts (including
deactivated), stored lower-cased. Password: 12–72 characters, confirmed. Role: administrator,
receptionist, or doctor. The pre-request script generates a unique synthetic email; the id is
stored in `staff_member_id` for the next requests.

response.name: 422 Email taken
response.body: {"message": "The email has already been taken.", "errors": {"email": ["The email has already been taken."]}}

request.description: One staff account by id. Unknown id → 404 with a translated message.

exec: pm.test('200 with the new name and role', () => {

request.description:
Change name, email, and/or role (at least one). Changing the role of the only active
administrator is refused with 422. A new role applies on the member's next request.
Set a new password for a staff member; ends all of that member's tokens.
Allow a deactivated account to sign in again (earlier tokens stay invalid). Idempotent.

Deactivate an account and end all of its tokens immediately. Idempotent. Refused with 422 if it
is the only active administrator. Runs last in this folder, so a collection run leaves the
synthetic member it created deactivated.

response.name: 422 Last administrator
response.body: {"message": "This change would leave the clinic without an active administrator."}

item.name: Patients
item.description:
Patient registration and records (feature 003): administrators and receptionists only; doctors
get 403 on every request. The patient number is the record's `id`. Lists never include the
national ID, address, or emergency contact. Contract:
`specs/003-patient-records/contracts/patients.openapi.yaml`.

request.description:
Register a patient. Required: full_name, date_of_birth (not in the future, at most 130 years
ago), sex (male/female), phone (8–15 digits, optional leading +; spaces and dashes removed).
Optional: national_id (14 digits, first digit 2 or 3, unique), address, emergency_contact
{name, relationship, phone}. The new id is stored in `patient_id`. Synthetic data only.

response.name: 422 Invalid fields
response.body: {"message":"The phone number field format is invalid. (and 1 more error)","errors":{"phone":["The phone number field format is invalid."],"national_id":["The national ID field format is invalid."]}}

query.description: Exact, after removing spaces and dashes

request.description:
One page of patients ordered by name, then id. Filters combine with AND. Name search ignores
case, extra spaces, and the Arabic variants أ/إ/آ = ا, ة = ه, ى = ي. Items have exactly id,
full_name, sex, date_of_birth, phone.

response.name: 403 Doctor
response.body: {"message":"You are not allowed to perform this action."}

request.description: The full record, including national ID, address, and emergency contact. Unknown id: 404.

Partial update: send only the fields to change; `null` clears an optional field. The patient
number never changes. An empty body gets 422 on `fields`.

response.name: 422 Nothing to update
response.body: {"message":"Send at least one field to change.","errors":{"fields":["Send at least one field to change."]}}

item.name: Specialties
item.description:
Specialty catalog (feature 004, US1). Every active staff member can list it; only
administrators add, rename, deactivate, and reactivate. Specialties always return both
`name_en` and `name_ar`, whatever the request language, and are never deleted. Contract:
`specs/004-doctors-specialties/contracts/doctors.openapi.yaml`.

exec: pm.test('200 with both names on every specialty', () => {

query.description: 1 for active only, 0 for deactivated only

request.description: The whole catalog (unpaginated), ordered by English name.

Add an active specialty. Both names required, at most 100 characters, each unique (case and
extra spaces ignored, deactivated specialties included). The pre-request script makes the
synthetic names unique; the id is stored in `specialty_id`.

response.name: 422 Name taken
response.body: {"message":"The English name has already been taken.","errors":{"name_en":["The English name has already been taken."]}}
